title: Multi-step worked-example interactive walkthrough
summary: Companion-app surface that turns the static worked-example sections the LLM emits today into a step-through experience: pupil reveals step 1, attempts step 2 themselves, gets G1's verifier feedback on their attempt, then reveals the model step. Builds on G1's verifier infrastructure.

in: client/src/lib/workedExampleStepper.ts (new, ~150 LoC) — pure state machine over a worked-example section's steps
client/src/pages/companion/[token].tsx — wire the walkthrough for sections of type 'worked-example'
shared/aiSchemas.ts — additive: section.workedExampleSteps?: { stepNumber, prompt, expectedAnswer?, methodMark?, modelAnswer }[]
client/src/lib/promptSections/workedExampleStepperDirective.ts (new, ~80 LoC) — instructs the LLM to emit structured steps when the worksheet wants the walkthrough
Targeted vitest: stepper transitions (locked → revealed → attempted → fed-back → next-locked); verifier integration
out: Multi-step support beyond mathematical worked examples (deferred — v1 ships maths-flavoured stepper)
Voice-narrated walkthrough (deferred — could combine with H5)

acceptance_criteria: Worked-example sections without structured steps fall back to the existing static rendering (backwards compatible).
Pupil cannot skip ahead — step N+1 is locked until step N has been revealed (model) or attempted (verifier-fed-back).
Verifier accepts pupil's attempt at step N and surfaces G1's tick/cross + the existing hint ladder.
Walkthrough's step state persists in companion-answer-log so a pupil can resume mid-walkthrough on next visit.
